static_traits.name: Tang Mingjie
static_traits.family_status: From a large family with 8 siblings, she is the youngest
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of trustworthy friends
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem history; no psychotherapy or counseling received yet; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; cooperativeness Good; able to engage in self-Reflection; tending to repeatedly think about negative events; emotional experience of feeling down, disappointed, and guilty

basic_info.main_problem: Because one sibling did not attend last month's birthday party, I have been feeling sad and guilty, believing the whole event was ruined.
basic_info.core_demands: This event keeps affecting my mood and Interpersonal relationships; I hope for guidance on coping with these feelings; I want to move on and not let it affect me so much.

core_beliefs: I am not cared about / I am not important
Only when all family members are present does it show I am valued and the matter counts as successful

special_situations.event: One sibling had not yet arrived at the birthday party
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not all family members attend, it means they do not care about me, and my party does not count as successful
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly revisiting and seeking the reason for the absence (asking the person, discussing with friends, trying to rationalize), to ease the discomfort of uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not care about me, the whole birthday was ruined

special_situations.event: Most family and friends attended and the atmosphere was Good, but one's attention was drawn to the absent sibling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The good parts do not count; only full attendance shows this was good/worthwhile
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive details, letting negative fragments dominate the evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Others coming does not matter; one person not coming proves this was not worthwhile

special_situations.event: Not yet obtaining a clear Interpretation of the sibling's absence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no clear reason, it means not caring or unwillingness to come
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Filling information gaps with speculation, presetting others' negative motives
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He/she did not want to come, not caring about me

special_situations.event: One poor interaction with a client at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is one negative interaction, the day is ruined and it shows my work performance is poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lets one negative event dominate the whole day's evaluation, ignoring other positive experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today is all bad; work is a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and valued by family at important moments, expecting a complete reunion and the feeling of being cared for
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being ignored, Relationship estrangement, one's important moments not being acknowledged
defense_goal: Gaining certainty and easing Anxiety through personalization and reason-seeking
Lets negative interpretations dominate to maintain a sense of control over the meaning of relationships

object_relations.object_representation: Important others (family) who do not care about / value oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When an important other (such as a sibling) is absent without a clear Interpretation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other does not care about oneself, absence equals contempt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In an Empathy, gently probing tone, first validating the disappointment and uncertainty, then inviting multiple possible Interpretations, avoiding a single negative attribution.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When trying to ease discomfort but lacking information, unable to reach a clear conclusion
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Finding seemingly reasonable explanations for the other person's absence and one's own feelings, to ease inner conflict
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keeping a neutral, non-judgmental tone, distinguishing facts from speculation, encouraging evidence-based examination of Interpretations, while allowing and accommodating the not-yet-resolved parts.

manifestations: Understanding a loved one's absence as not being cared about and being ignored
Longing to be seen and accompanied at important moments, but struggling to tolerate uncertainty and absence
Repeatedly ruminating on the event due to not yet obtaining an Interpretation
outcomes: Daily activities overshadowed by negative emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributing the sibling's absence to 'not caring about me' 'not wanting to come'
Presetting others' negative motives when information is incomplete

contact_model.definition: Having poor self-Reflection and harsh self-blame, being overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Continuously feels guilty, believes 'the whole gathering was ruined'
Self-denial over one poor Work interaction, letting it affect the whole day's mood

exception_events.target_problem: At important Family gatherings, when one member is absent, the client typically ruminates repeatedly and believes the whole event was ruined, feeling Low mood and unable to enjoy the present.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At multiple moments on the night of the birthday party, the client interacted pleasantly with the family and friends present, received thoughtful gifts; everyone was genuinely happy, laughed together, the food was also satisfying, and they experienced positive feelings at that time.
exception_events.reason: Different support: most family and friends attended and expressed care; different approach: noticing and recalling positive moments in the present, thus briefly deviating from the dominant 'whole event ruined' narrative.

positive_force: The actual support and care of most family and friends
Willing to seek help and accept suggestions of cognitive restructuring and mindfulness practice
Able to recall and identify positive details and beautiful moments
negative_force: Mental filtering and negating the positive, overgeneralization and personalization
Low tolerance for uncertainty, tending toward worst-case assumptions
Ruminative habit keeps negative emotions going and amplifies them

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly ruminates on the birthday-absence incident and magnifies the negative details
antecedent: Recalling details of the birthday party
Not yet obtaining a clear Interpretation of the reason for absence
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing and mind-reading inferences with incomplete information, interpreting absence as 'not being cared about', and maintaining this Interpretation through overgeneralization and negating the positive
target_behavior.function: Gaining subjective certainty and control, trying to lower the Anxiety of being ignored
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent disappointment and guilt, affecting Work performance, Interpersonal relationships, and daily activities

target_behavior.behavior: A whole day of Low mood over one negative client interaction, judging 'the whole day ruined'
antecedent: One poor interaction with a client
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and mental filtering, extending a single negative event to the overall work performance and the day's experience
target_behavior.function: Finds a 'unified explanation' for emotions through negative evaluation, avoiding more complex emotional processing
target_behavior.consequence: Work efficiency and professional state decline; lacks perception of other positive experiences that day
